'''August 2000 Marlton tournament (20 August)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Great Traditions, Marlton, NJ on 20 August 2000. [[Livio D'Alessio]] won it. It is known from Doug Faust's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1155">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-22-marlton-nj-20-aug-00d1155/ marlton-nj-20-aug-00], DeckTech (Doug "Phrim" Faust, 22 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-22-marlton-nj-20-aug-00d1155/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 20 August 2000
* '''Site:''' Great Traditions, Marlton, NJ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Livio D'Alessio]]
